cues.zh: 我想提供五TB的数据。
cues.en: I would like to serve five terabytes of data.

cues.zh: 没问题，我们可是Google。五TB小得我都忘了怎么数这么小的数了。
cues.en: No problem, we are Google. Five terabytes is so little that I've forgotten how to count that low.

cues.zh: 太好了！那我就用appengine，肯定很简单。
cues.en: Great! I'll use appengine, that will be easy.

cues.zh: 非常简单。只要注册一个appengine账号，写点Python，写单元测试，
cues.en: Very easy. Just register an appengine account, write a little Python, write unit tests,

cues.zh: 写回归测试，写端到端测试，创建一个CL，通过提交队列，
cues.en: write a regression test, write an end-to-end test, create a CL, pass the submit queue,

cues.zh: 让CL获批，等构建变绿，然后提交就行了。
cues.en: get the CL approved, wait for the build to go green, and submit it.

cues.zh: 太好了，那只要一周就够了。
cues.en: Great, that will only take a week.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，我的数据是由内部cron任务生成的——这会有问题吗？
cues.en: By the way my, data is generated by an internal cron job- will that be a problem?

cues.zh: 这里是Google。你得把数据存进bigtable。
cues.en: This is Google. You'll need to store the data in a bigtable.

cues.zh: 这有点麻烦，不过为了生产质量的服务，我想还是值得的。
cues.en: That's kind of a pain but I suppose it's worthwhile for a production quality service.

cues.zh: 你管那叫生产质量？我今天早上蹲厕所时随手做的
cues.en: You call that production quality? I made a more robust production quality

cues.zh: 服务都比那更健壮、更有生产质量。
cues.en: service squatting over the toilet this morning.

cues.zh: 为什么 App Engine 和 Bigtable 达不到生产质量？
cues.en: Why is appengine and bigtable not production quality?

cues.zh: 哦天哪。当 PCR 打到你的服务单元时会发生什么？
cues.en: Oh sweet lord in heaven. What happens when a PCR hits your serving cell?

cues.zh: PCR？
cues.en: A PCR?

cues.zh: 计划变更请求。
cues.en: Planed change request.

cues.zh: 这里是 Google。你需要把数据复制到多个 Bigtable 单元。
cues.en: This is Google. You need to replicate your data across multiple bigtable cells.

cues.zh: 我该怎么做？
cues.en: How do I do that?

cues.zh: 只需在两个 Bigtable 单元里购买配额。
cues.en: Just purchase quota in two bigtable cells.

cues.zh: 搞定。现在我的服务达到生产质量了吗？
cues.en: Done. Now is my service production quality?

cues.zh: 你真逗。你确认两个单元都在不同的 PCR 区域了吗？
cues.en: You are so funny. Did you make sure that both cells are in different PCR zones?

cues.zh: 我没意识到还得操心这个。你怎么不早说？
cues.en: I didn't realize I had to worry about that. Why didn't you tell me?

cues.zh: 听着，我只想服务 5TB 数据。这不该这么难。
cues.en: Look, I just want to serve 5 terabytes. This shouldn't be hard.

cues.zh: 不难。这里是 Google。顺便说一句，记得提交工单来复制你的单元。
cues.en: It's not hard. This is Google. By the way, make sure you file a ticket to replicate your cells.

cues.zh: 搞定。现在我的服务达到生产质量了吗？
cues.en: Done. Now is my service production quality?

cues.zh: 如果你在 Yahoo，那当然行。这里是 Google。你需要在 PCR 区域之间干净地故障转移。
cues.en: If you're Yahoo, sure. This is Google. You need to fail-over cleanly between PCR zones.

cues.zh: 直接启动两个单元格，创建一个 corp GFE DNS 条目，指向这两个实例之间。
cues.en: Just launch into both cells and create a corp GFE DNS entry to point between the two instances.

cues.zh: 我开始讨厌你了。但好吧，我来做。现在我的服务达到生产质量了吗？
cues.en: I am beginning to hate you. But fine, I will do that. Now is my service production quality?

cues.zh: 除非你觉得你的用户是垃圾。你是这么想的吗？你觉得你的用户是垃圾吗？那你为什么
cues.en: Only if you think your users are scum. Do you? Do you think your users are scum? Why do you

cues.zh: 恨你的用户？服务宕机时你怎么知道？你设置监控了吗？
cues.en: hate your users? How will you know when your service goes down? Have you set up monitoring?

cues.zh: 我只想提供五TB的服务。为什么这么难？好吧，
cues.en: I just want to serve five terabytes. Why is this so difficult? Fine,

cues.zh: 我用 Diplomat 写点东西；我听说 Diplomat 不错。
cues.en: I will write something in Diplomat; I've heard good things about Diplomat.

cues.zh: 你给你的 borg 任务起了合适的 diplomat 名字吗？
cues.en: Did you give your borg jobs the appropriate names for diplomat?

cues.zh: 我的天，你是在开玩笑吧。算了，那我就用 borgmon。
cues.en: Sweet jesus, you have got to be kidding me. Never mind then, I'll just use borgmon.

cues.zh: 很好。只要改改别人的 borgmon 代码，你就可以上路了。
cues.en: Good. Just modify someone else's borgmon code and you're good to go.

cues.zh: 你只需要找一个能看懂 borgmon 的人。
cues.en: You just need to find someone with borgmon readability.

cues.zh: 谁能看懂 borgmon？
cues.en: Who has borgmon readability?

cues.zh: 没人能看懂 borgmon。只有我，但我没时间审查你的代码。
cues.en: No one has borgmon readability. Just me, but I don't have time to review your code.

cues.zh: 你要是帮我审查代码，我就给你一个同事奖励。
cues.en: I will give you a peer bonus if you review my code.

cues.zh: 一个同事奖励？低于三个我都不起床。
cues.en: One peer bonus? I don't get out of bed for less than three.

cues.zh: 这不太符合谷歌范儿，但行吧。三个同事奖励。现在来审查我这 20 行 borgmon 代码。
cues.en: That's not very googly, but fine. Three peer bonuses. Now review my 20 lines of borgmon code.

cues.zh: 我看没问题。
cues.en: Looks good to me.

cues.zh: 我需要审批。
cues.en: I need approval.

cues.zh: 审批要再加三个同事奖励。
cues.en: Approval costs three more peer bonuses.

cues.zh: 你要不是个资深软件工程师，我早就
cues.en: If you weren't a staff software engineer I would

cues.zh: 把你像湿透的杂货袋一样剖开，拿你的内脏玩跳房子了。
cues.en: cut you open like a wet bag of groceries and play hopscotch with your entrails.

cues.zh: 行吧，现在批准我的 CL。
cues.en: Fine, now approve my CL.

cues.zh: 搞定。顺便问一下，你记得给 borgmon 要运行的那个 cell 买配额了吗？
cues.en: Done. By the way, did you remember to purchase quota for the cell where borgmon will run?

cues.zh: 我要辞职了。我的下一份工作会让你的
cues.en: I am going to quit my job. My next job will be making your

cues.zh: 重要器官变得人人可访问、人人可用。
cues.en: vital organs universally accessible and useful.
